# Unmeasured disagreement

`customer_support.heu.quality_assurance.unmeasured_disagreement` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> Reviewer disagreement you have not measured is disagreement you have.


## The heuristic

**Reviewer disagreement you have not measured is disagreement you have.**


_Why:_ Two reviewers scoring the same ticket apart is the default condition of any rubric until proven otherwise. An uncalibrated programme reports reviewer variance as agent variance, which means every conclusion drawn from it is attributed to the wrong person.
